recipe.visualDefinition: A vast, repeating grid of hundreds of vintage iron hospital beds stretching into the distance along a wide, sandy beach under a hazy, purple-tinted sky. A lone figure sits contemplatively on one of the beds in the foreground, creating a sense of isolation amidst mass repetition.
coreVisualRelationships: The rhythmic repetition of bed frames creates a forced perspective leading to the horizon.
The organic texture of the sand contrasts with the rigid, industrial geometry of the metal beds.
The lone human figure acts as a scale reference and emotional anchor within the mechanical grid.
The muted, monochromatic purple sky creates a dreamlike, non-naturalistic atmosphere.
coreInvariants: Wrought iron bed frames with circular headboard motifs
Vast expanse of wet sand reflecting soft light
A winding, serpentine arrangement of beds in the far distance

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary human subject is seated slightly off-center in the mid-ground, scaled to appear small against the infinite grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The foreground bed frames, rendered with high detail and sharp shadows, anchor the bottom third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the rows of beds from the bottom-left and bottom-right, converging toward the center-right horizon line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is dominated by a flat, featureless purple sky, providing breathing room for the complex ground detail.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sandy ochre and muted tan provide the base ground color.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep purple and mauve tones dominate the sky and atmospheric shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Occasional pops of primary colors (blue, yellow, red) on bed linens break the monochromatic repetition.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a narrow value range, creating a soft, low-contrast 'hazy' look.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid vibrant greens or bright blues

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle shot of a flat beach at dusk. The sky is a solid, hazy purple-pink. Hundreds of identical Victorian-style iron bed frames with white pillows and various colored blankets are arranged in a grid that curves into the distance. A single man in dark clothing sits on the edge of one bed in the center-left mid-ground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a thin, spaced-out serif font placed in the upper third of the sky to maintain the minimalist, surrealist tone.

verificationChecks: Ensure the beds recede into the distance following a clear perspective line.
Check that the sky color is a consistent, muted purple without clouds.
Verify the iron bed frames have a consistent circular design in the headboards.

adjustableVariables: Time of day (from bright daylight to deep twilight)
The specific pose of the central figure
The amount of water/tide visible on the right side
mustRedesign: Any modern furniture styles; must remain vintage iron frames.
High-contrast, sunny lighting; must remain hazy and atmospheric.
postGenerationChecks: Does the image feel like a physical installation rather than a digital collage?
Is the horizon line level and the perspective convincing?
Are the shadows consistent with a low, diffused light source?
Does the lone figure look integrated into the scene?
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist landscape + repeating industrial objects + vast natural environment + monochromatic atmospheric tint + lone observer.
